decisions.reason: The air quality module was given its own page and a dedicated launch, and environmental sensing demand stays strong, so it is a valuable option that costs little to keep in a modular catalog.
As the current 3.0 generation of a core analog measurement module, it carries basic platform functionality and costs little to maintain, so it should stay until a successor generation replaces it.
A CAN bus interface serves lasting automation and vehicle use cases, and its value is still unfolding, so keeping this cheap option open is justified.
The CO2 sensor gained relevance from indoor ventilation monitoring after 2020 and has its own page, so the evidence favors keeping it, with some risk of a revision replacing it.
